name: Panta OEM Field Diagnostics — Eaton AMT and Freightliner Cascadia J1939
usage_note: Retrieval-oriented paraphrases from authoritative OEM technical material. Preserve applicability. These are diagnostic starting points, not substitutes for VIN/model-specific service procedures.

documents.title: Eaton automated transmission shift complaint with no transmission fault codes
documents.authority: OEM — Eaton RWRG0067 warranty repair guideline
documents.applicability: Eaton automated-transmission shift complaints matching RWRG0067 symptom pattern. Confirm exact transmission/application before repair.
documents.summary: For this Eaton no-code AMT shift complaint, do not assume internal transmission failure. Eaton identifies engine power or derate problems, engine software or parameter compatibility, accessory-load errors, degraded data-link communication, module grounds and unintended ABS or traction-control events as possible causes. Diagnose engine and vehicle faults, engine performance, parameters, accessory loads and network/ABS behavior before condemning the transmission.

documents.title: Freightliner Cascadia J1939 and Truck CAN resistance checks
documents.authority: OEM technical training solution — Freightliner/Daimler TS 1033683, archived by NHTSA
documents.applicability: Cascadia architecture covered by TS 1033683. New Cascadia has a different architecture; use its specific literature.
documents.summary: With ignition off and batteries disconnected, TS 1033683 checks Diagnostic Truck CAN between diagnostic pins H and J and J1939/H1939 500k between pins C and D. The OEM target is 60 ohms plus or minus 3 ohms. An out-of-spec result is a network clue, not proof a particular module failed; isolate using vehicle-specific termination and wiring information.

documents.title: Freightliner Cascadia J1939 H1939 voltage diagnosis
documents.authority: OEM technical training solution — Freightliner/Daimler TS 1033683, archived by NHTSA
documents.applicability: Cascadia architecture covered by TS 1033683; New Cascadia architecture differs.
documents.summary: With ignition on, engine off and good connected batteries, TS 1033683 gives about 2.6 V plus or minus 0.1 V from diagnostic pin A to C and 2.3 V plus or minus 0.1 V from A to D. No voltage can indicate a backbone or module short; fluctuating voltage can indicate polarity trouble; out-of-range voltage can be module-related. Monitor voltage while isolating modules, then verify suspect-branch power, ground and network conditions before replacement.
